extras: Supports bilingual UI (English and Persian) and includes term normalization for Persian and Arabic.
intentEvidence: Highlight Reference turns Obsidian's built-in ==highlight== syntax into an interactive knowledge reference.
problem: It addresses the need to keep existing Markdown workflows while connecting notes to central reference files without duplicating information.

relations.evidence: Highlight Reference can work alongside the Spaced Repetition plugin.

summary: Turns Obsidian's built-in ==highlight== syntax into an interactive knowledge reference by linking highlighted terms to definitions stored in separate Markdown notes.
